content.user_title: Diagnose Errors With Smart Debug Workflows
content.value_statement: Complex failures hide across traces, logs, and code paths. This skill guides structured triage, hypothesis ranking, instrumentation, fixes, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Classifies errors by symptoms, severity, environment, and failure pattern.
Builds ranked debugging hypotheses with evidence and falsification criteria.
Guides observability review across logs, traces, metrics, and error trackers.
Suggests safe breakpoint, logpoint, and instrumentation locations.
Produces fix proposals with impact, risk, rollback, and validation steps.
Creates post-fix prevention tasks for tests, monitoring, and runbooks.
limitations: It cannot access observability tools unless the host agent has those connections.
It depends on accurate error details, logs, traces, and reproduction steps.
It provides diagnostic guidance, not guaranteed root cause proof.
Production changes still need human review, testing, and release controls.

use_cases.title: Triage Production Incidents
use_cases.description: Turn alerts, stack traces, and service symptoms into ranked hypotheses and a validation plan.

use_cases.title: Debug Application Regressions
use_cases.description: Compare recent changes, failures, logs, and tests to identify likely code paths.

use_cases.title: Prepare Root Cause Reports
use_cases.description: Organize evidence, cause, fix, validation, and prevention steps into a structured report.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize This Error
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage from a stack trace or alert.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this error report. Summarize the likely impact, affected area, missing evidence, and first three debugging steps.

prompt_templates.title: Rank Debugging Hypotheses
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate diagnosis with logs and reproduction details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these symptoms, logs, and reproduction steps to create ranked hypotheses with evidence, probability, and falsification tests.

prompt_templates.title: Design Safe Instrumentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Production or staging issue that needs more evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest production-safe instrumentation for this issue. Include logpoints, trace attributes, sampling guidance, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create Fix And Validation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow after a likely root cause is known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a fix proposal for this suspected root cause. Include change scope, risk, tests, rollout plan, monitoring, and prevention tasks.

output_examples.input: Checkout requests time out for some users after the latest release.
output: Issue summary with affected flow, frequency, severity, and recent deployment context.
Ranked hypotheses covering external API latency, database query growth, and configuration drift.
Validation plan using traces, error tracking, latency comparison, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: A background worker fails intermittently with missing state errors.
output: Root cause report structure with evidence gaps and likely race condition indicators.
Instrumentation plan for job lifecycle events, state transitions, and retry behavior.
Prevention plan covering regression tests, alerts, and runbook updates.

best_practices: Provide stack traces, timestamps, deployment history, and affected environments.
Validate each hypothesis with evidence before changing production behavior.
Record the final root cause, fix, tests, and monitoring changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the first plausible explanation as the confirmed cause.
Do not add broad production logging without sampling, privacy review, and cleanup.
Do not skip rollback planning for fixes that affect live traffic.

faq.question: Does this skill run debugging tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured workflow and depends on the host agent for any available tools.

faq.question: Can it diagnose production incidents?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide alerts, logs, traces, metrics, and deployment context.

faq.question: Does it replace observability platforms?
faq.answer: No. It helps interpret evidence from platforms such as logs, traces, metrics, and error trackers.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Use stack traces, reproduction steps, timestamps, recent changes, affected services, and expected behavior.

faq.question: Can it suggest code fixes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose fix direction, impact, tests, rollout steps, and rollback criteria.

faq.question: Is it useful before the root cause is known?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to rank hypotheses and identify the next evidence to collect.
